versions.changelog:
Initial release of pumpview-trading skill.

- Connects to PumpView API for Solana trading, swap submissions, wallet onboarding, and live trade data.
- Supports locally signed swap building, volume tracking, and receipt inspection.
- Allows API and browser onboarding flows with install source tracking (`clawhub`, `skills_sh`, `github`, `agent_kit`).
- Enables access to trading, volume, and live data endpoints; handles paid data packages and recovery flows.
- Emphasizes secure wallet integration and precise economic intent preservation in all operations.
